messages:
Erin (Sales): Heads up — CodaHealth POC is ready for contract. Procurement requires a PO before e-sign and wants net45. They also sent an MSA with DPA redlines. Can legal/finance triage?
Ben (Legal): Please drop their redline PDF here. Quick flags: KMS wording and subprocessor list will be the usual sticking points.
Erin (Sales): Uploaded their file: https://redwood.app/drive/CODA-OF-v3.pdf. They explicitly requested vendor-managed keys and a shorter subprocessor notice window. Also want invoice-to PO number printed on the DocuSign first page.
Rachel (Finance): Net45 is acceptable for enterprise but need CFO sign-off if the first order > $50k. We prefer PO before billing — that aligns with their ask. If they insist on vendor-managed KMS we need to escalate to security/legal.
Sam (Eng): For the POC we can keep them on hosted EU region (eu-west-1) to satisfy residency. If they escalate to on-prem/private later, that’s a separate SOW. Also confirm whether logs/PII are allowed in the POC dataset.
Ben (Legal): Skimmed the redline. Plan: I can take a pass to (1) refuse vendor-managed KMS for Private deployments, (2) propose hosted exception language with technical controls, (3) tighten the subprocessor notice window to 30 days. I’ll attach the redline.
Erin (Sales): Need DocuSign routing guidance. Procurement wants: procurement approver -> finance -> exec. Legal wants to review before final exec sign. If PO required first, we have to include a checkbox in the envelope flow.
OpsBot: Drafting envelope `CO-OF-2156789000` in DocuSign sandbox. Draft signers (can be reordered):
```
signers:
  - procurement (Procurement Rep)
  - finance (Rachel (Finance))
  - legal (Ben (Legal))
  - exec (Customer Exec)
```
Fallback rule: if procurement signs first, route to finance next. Envelope URL: https://docusign.redwood/ENVELOPE/2156789000 (sandbox).
Rachel (Finance): Add billing routing: invoices to `billing@redwood.com`, PO number on invoice header, invoice on activation for POC. Note: if PO comes later than 30 days we need payment assurance (CC or prepay).
Ben (Legal): Uploaded redline: https://redwood.app/drive/CODA-OF-v3-redline.pdf. Key snippet I changed: "Customer-managed KMS required for Private deployments; Hosted API will use Redwood-managed keys with documented controls and opt-in CMK option." Also added SOC2 attestation clause and pen-test summary delivery timeline.
Erin (Sales): Great. I'll send redline + DocuSign draft to CodaHealth and ask for PO contact. Quick ask: can we accept net45 tied to signed date (not activation)? Rachel?
Rachel (Finance): Yes — net45 from signed date is fine for this customer contingent on CFO OK. For billing please request PO number in the first 48 hours of signing.
Sam (Eng): I'll prepare a short data residency appendix that pins them to eu-west-1 and lists what logs are retained. Will attach to the order form.
Erin (Sales): Next steps checklist: Ben push final redline (EOD), OpsBot send DocuSign envelope with PO checkbox, Rachel confirm CFO threshold paperwork, Sam attach residency appendix. I’ll message procurement to get PO contact and eta. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Envelope moved to "for signature" status in prod once legal approves redline. Draft ID retained: `env-2156789000-prod`. Fallback route created for alternate signer order.
Ben (Legal): One more note for negotiation: if customer insists on vendor-managed keys for hosted, add compensating controls (audit logs, dedicated tenancy, SOC2). I’ll leave comments in the redline for sales to use in the thread.
Erin (Sales): Sending to customer now. Will follow up in this thread with PO number and DocuSign status.
Rachel (Finance): If PO delayed >10 business days escalate to me — we’ll decide on prepay or credit hold.
Sam (Eng): Uploaded appendix draft: https://redwood.app/drive/CODA-OF-eu-residency-appendix-draft.pdf.
Erin (Sales): Thanks all — feel free to ping me if you need anything else.
